ADBE.thesis: A high-return, cash-generative subscription franchise priced below its own 5-year valuation floor for AI disruption that has not yet shown up in margins or returns.

triggers.text: Gross margin falls below 85%, indicating commoditisation of Creative/Document Cloud by AI tools.
Operating margin falls below 34%, indicating sustained pricing or margin erosion.
ROIC falls below 40%, indicating loss of the pricing power underpinning the thesis.

BKNG.thesis: A high-return, highly cash-generative travel marketplace trading below its five-year valuation range on AI-disintermediation fears that its reported margins and returns do not yet show.

triggers.text: Operating margin falls below 30% (FY2025 35.2%), signalling take-rate or share loss to AI agents.
ROIC falls below 50% (TTM 92.5%), signalling returns being competed away.
FCF conversion (FCF/net income) falls below 100% for a fiscal year (TTM 132.3%), signalling earnings-quality deterioration.

HKG:2628.thesis: China's largest state-backed life insurer trades at its own 5-year-low P/B with a five-year rising ROE trend, offering value even if TTM investment-driven earnings normalise.

triggers.text: ROE (TTM, statistics page) falls below 14.8%, the FY2023 level, showing the improvement was not durable.
ROIC (TTM, statistics page) falls below 9.0%, the FY2023 level, erasing the FY2021-FY2025 improvement trend.
Debt/EBITDA (statistics page) rises above 2.81x, the FY2023 site-definition level, reversing the deleveraging trend.
FCF conversion (FCF/net income, cash flow and income statement pages) turns negative, so cash earnings no longer track reported profit.

HKG:9999.thesis: A net-cash, high-margin game developer with five years of rising returns trades below its own 5-year EV/EBITDA and P/FCF minimums and at a 9.86% FCF yield, which prices in a regulatory overhang rather than the quality it has delivered.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below the FY2024 level of 28.1%, reversing the five-year expansion.
TTM FCF margin falls below the FY2024 level of 36.5%, signalling cash generation is no longer keeping pace.
TTM gross margin falls below the FY2024 level of 62.5%, indicating the game portfolio mix or monetization is deteriorating.
A new PRC regulation materially restricts game monetization, or a VIE-related regulatory action forces deconsolidation, as disclosed in an SEC 20-F/6-K filing.

NSE:TCS.thesis: A net-cash, 66% ROIC IT-services leader trading below its five-year multiple range on a 6.34% FCF yield, with stable operating margins, offers attractive 12-month risk/reward.

triggers.text: Operating margin falls below 24.1% (the FY2023 five-year low), showing pricing/wage pressure is now hitting operating profitability.
Gross margin falls below 38.3% (the FY2025 five-year low), showing the commoditisation is deepening.
ROIC falls below 64.6% (the FY2022 level), confirming the decline from 81.0% is structural erosion of the capital-return advantage.

PDD.thesis: A net-cash, still highly cash-generative marketplace priced below its own 5-year-low multiples, which already discounts more erosion in returns than the fundamentals show.

triggers.text: Gross margin falls below 50% TTM: subsidy competition is structurally eroding the model.
ROE falls below 15%: the Pinduoduo flywheel has lost its return advantage over peers.
FCF margin falls below 15%: cash generation no longer supports the valuation case.
Balance sheet turns net debt (net debt/EBITDA above zero) or FCF/NI stays below 100% for two consecutive fiscal years.

SHA:600036.thesis: A best-in-class Chinese retail and wealth bank bought at 0.8x book and 7.1x earnings, with a double-digit ROE and a rising net margin offsetting NIM compression.

triggers.text: ROE falls below 10%: the quality premium over peers is no longer earned.
Net (profit) margin falls below 45%: fee and cost mix no longer offsets NIM compression.

SHA:601899.thesis: A diversified copper-gold miner with structurally improved cash conversion and a deleveraged balance sheet trades below its own five-year valuation range and well below peers.

triggers.text: Gross margin falls below 20% (the FY2024 level), showing the margin expansion was purely cyclical
ROIC falls below 15%, back toward the FY2021-FY2023 range
FCF margin falls below 7.9% (the FY2024 level), reversing the cash-conversion improvement
Net debt/EBITDA (ratios page) rises back above 1.9x, reversing the deleveraging

TSX:ABX.thesis: A net-cash, low-cost gold major earning a 23.7% ROIC trades below its own 5-year multiple floor and peers, so the market is over-discounting margin reversion and Mali/IPO risk.

triggers.text: Gross margin falls below 40%, signalling reversion toward FY2022-23 margin levels.
ROIC falls below 10%, erasing the step-change in capital returns.
FCF margin falls below 10%, signalling capex overrun or a Mali disruption hitting cash generation.
Net debt/EBITDA (fact-sheet net definition) rises above 0.5x, signalling releveraging.
